sponsored.t: Extends provisions relating to public hearings on proposed rules
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions relating to public hearings on proposed rules until January 1, 2028.

sponsored.t: Increases the penalties imposed upon gas and electric utilities for failure to file or correct an annual report with the public service commission
sponsored.sum: Increases the penalties imposed upon gas and electric utilities for failure to file or correct an annual report with the public service commission; provides such penalties shall not be more than one-tenth of 1% of the utilities' annual net revenue for each day of violation, but not to exceed $25,000 nor be less than $100.

sponsored.t: Relates to the tangible property credit component of the brownfield redevelopment tax credit
sponsored.sum: Extends the tangible property credit component of the brownfield redevelopment tax credit for certain qualified sites which contain 40% open space and 25% affordable housing units.

sponsored.t: Authorizes children who will be 18 or older on the date of a permanency hearing to apply to dispense with the provision of notice and copy of the hearing report
sponsored.sum: Authorizes children who will be 18 or older on the date of a permanency hearing to apply to dispense with the provision of notice and copy of such hearing and to redact portions of the hearing report.

sponsored.t: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to the establishment of certain water charges for hospitals and charities in New York city
sponsored.sum: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to the establishment of certain water charges for hospitals and charities in New York city from September 1, 2026 until September 1, 2028.

sponsored.t: Provides that certain institutions of higher education shall meet certain standards that do not infringe upon academic freedom
sponsored.sum: Provides that certain institutions of higher education shall meet certain standards or adopt rules that do not infringe upon academic freedom; provides that academic freedom shall be defined by the 1940 Statement of Principles on Academic Freedom and Tenure with 1970 Interpretive Comments; establishes courses of action that may be taken int the event of alleged violations of academic freedom.

sponsored.t: Provides for the notification of individuals when their address confidentiality time period is expiring
sponsored.sum: Provides for the notification of individuals when their address confidentiality time period is expiring no later than six months prior to such expiration; provides that such notification shall include information on how to reapply.

sponsored.t: Warns voters about New York's closed primary system on voter registration forms
sponsored.sum: Provides voters with a warning about New York's closed primary system on voter registration forms.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "Not on our dime!: Ending New York funding of Israeli settler violence act" to prohibit not-for-profit corporations from engaging in unauthorized support of Israeli settlement activity
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "Not on our dime!: Ending New York funding of Israeli settler violence act" to prohibit not-for-profit corporations from engaging in unauthorized support of Israeli settlement activity; allows for recovery of a civil penalty by the state attorney general; creates a private right of action for violations.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing tax rates imposed on unincorporated businesses and corporations in New York city
sponsored.sum: Increases tax rates imposed on unincorporated businesses and corporations in New York city upon adoption of a local law by the local legislative body of the city of New York.
